name: YouTube Upload Video
description: Đăng 1 video lên YouTube Studio: chọn file, tiêu đề, mô tả, đối tượng, KIẾM TIỀN (monetize=1 bật / 0 tắt, tự đánh giá 'An toàn cho quảng cáo'), rồi CÔNG KHAI/RIÊNG TƯ/KHÔNG CÔNG KHAI (visibility_radio) hoặc HẸN GIỜ. Biến: video_path, title, description, monetize, visibility_radio, schedule, schedule_date, schedule_time.

t2:open-upload — bấm Tạo → Tải video lên nếu hộp thoại chưa mở
BẬT tự đóng bảng feedback/tooltip (chạy nền cả phiên)

params.code: (()=>{if(window.__t2fbkiller)return 'already';const kill=()=>{try{document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]').forEach(dg=>{const h=dg.querySelector('h1,h2,[role=heading]');const ht=(h&&h.textContent)||'';if(/send feedback|gửi phản hồi/i.test(ht)){const c=dg.querySelector('[aria-label=Close],[aria-label=Đóng]');if(c)c.click();}});for(const e of document.querySelectorAll('*')){if(e.children.length===0){const tx=(e.textContent||'').trim();if(/^(OK, Got it|Got it|Tôi hiểu|OK, tôi hiểu)$/i.test(tx)){let a=e;for(let i=0;i<4&&a;i++){if(a.tagName==='BUTTON'||(a.getAttribute&&a.getAttribute('role')==='button'))break;a=a.parentElement}try{(a||e).click()}catch(x){}}}}}catch(e){}};window.__t2fbkiller=setInterval(kill,700);kill();return 'installed'})()

params.code: (()=>{const fd=(r)=>{for(const e of r.querySelectorAll('[role=checkbox]')){const al=(e.getAttribute('aria-label')||'');if(/không chứa nội dung|none of the above/i.test(al))return e;}for(const e of r.querySelectorAll('*')){if(e.shadowRoot){const x=fd(e.shadowRoot);if(x)return x;}}return null;};const el=fd(document);if(!el)return 'no';if(el.getAttribute('aria-checked')==='true')return 'already';el.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});el.click();return 'ok';})()

then_steps.label: Mở phần Lên lịch (thử tới khi hiện lịch)

params.code: (()=>{if('{{schedule}}'!=='1')return 'x';if(document.querySelector('#datepicker-trigger'))return 'already';const RX=/^(schedule|lên lịch|len lich|planifier|programar|programa|zeitplan|スケジュール|일정)$/i;for(const e of document.querySelectorAll('*')){if(e.children.length===0){const tx=(e.textContent||'').trim();if(RX.test(tx)){const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.width>0&&r.top>240&&r.top<820){let a=e;for(let i=0;i<6&&a&&a.parentElement;i++){a=a.parentElement;const rr=a.getBoundingClientRect();if(rr.width>300&&rr.height>40&&rr.height<130){break}}(a||e).setAttribute('data-t2sched','1');(a||e).scrollIntoView({block:'center'});return 'tagged'}}}}return 'no-row'})()

then_steps.label: Dựng ngày theo NGÔN NGỮ YouTube (<html lang> + Intl) + đánh dấu

params.code: (()=>{if('{{schedule}}'!=='1')return 'x';const EN=["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"];const src='{{schedule_date}}';const sm=src.match(/([A-Za-z]{3,})\s+(\d{1,2}),?\s+(\d{4})/);if(!sm)return 'badsrc:'+src;const M=EN.findIndex(x=>x.toLowerCase()===sm[1].slice(0,3).toLowerCase())+1;const D=parseInt(sm[2],10),Y=parseInt(sm[3],10);if(!M)return 'badmon';const loc=(document.documentElement.getAttribute('lang')||navigator.language||'en');const dObj=new Date(Y,M-1,D);let inp=null;document.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(e=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();const v=(e.value||'');if(r.width>0&&r.top>60&&r.top<900&&v.length<=24&&/\d{4}/.test(v)&&!/:/.test(v)){if(!inp)inp=e}});if(!inp)inp=document.querySelector("ytcp-date-picker input, tp-yt-datetime-picker input, #datepicker-trigger input, [id*=datepicker] input");if(!inp)return 'no-input';const cur=(inp.value||'');let out;if(/thg/i.test(cur))out=D+' thg '+M+', '+Y;else if(/^[A-Za-z]{3}\.?\s+\d{1,2},/.test(cur))out=EN[M-1]+' '+D+', '+Y;else{try{out=new Intl.DateTimeFormat(loc,{year:'numeric',month:'short',day:'numeric'}).format(dObj)}catch(e){out=EN[M-1]+' '+D+', '+Y}}inp.setAttribute('data-t2date','1');return out})()

then_steps.label: Dựng giờ theo NGÔN NGỮ YouTube (Intl, 24h/12h theo ô) + đánh dấu

params.code: (()=>{if('{{schedule}}'!=='1')return 'x';const src='{{schedule_time}}';const sm=src.match(/(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*([AP]M)?/i);if(!sm)return 'badsrc:'+src;let H=parseInt(sm[1],10);const Mi=parseInt(sm[2],10);const ap=(sm[3]||'').toUpperCase();if(ap==='PM'&&H<12)H+=12;if(ap==='AM'&&H===12)H=0;const mm=(Mi<10?'0':'')+Mi;const loc=(document.documentElement.getAttribute('lang')||navigator.language||'en');const tObj=new Date(2000,0,1,H,Mi);let inp=null;document.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(e=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();const v=(e.value||'');if(r.width>0&&r.top>60&&r.top<900&&v.length<=12&&/\d{1,2}[:.]\d{2}/.test(v)){if(!inp)inp=e}});if(!inp)inp=document.querySelector("ytcp-time-of-day-picker input, [id*=time-of-day] input, [id*=time] input");if(!inp)return 'no-input';const cur=(inp.value||'');const stripped=cur.replace(/[\d:.\s\u00a0]/g,'');let out;if(stripped.length>0){try{out=new Intl.DateTimeFormat(loc,{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit',hour12:true}).format(tObj)}catch(e){const h12=(H%12)||12;out=h12+':'+mm+' '+(H<12?'AM':'PM')}}else{const sep=/\d[.]\d/.test(cur)?'.':':';const pad=/^\d{2}[:.]/.test(cur);out=(pad?((H<10?'0':'')+H):(''+H))+sep+mm}inp.setAttribute('data-t2time','1');return out})()

steps.label: Chờ nút Xuất bản/Lên lịch bật
t2:wait-upload — chờ video tải lên xong rồi mới bấm Xuất bản

params.break_on: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('ytcp-video-upload-progress'); const t = el ? (el.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() : ''; if (/\d+\s*%/.test(t)) return false; if ('{{schedule}}' !== '1') { const r = document.querySelector("tp-yt-paper-radio-button[name='{{visibility_radio}}']"); if (r && r.getAttribute('aria-checked') !== 'true') return false; } const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('#done-button')].find((e) => e.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0); return !!b; })()

params.code: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('ytcp-video-upload-progress'); const t = el ? (el.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 90) : 'no upload progress bar'; let fix = ''; if ('{{schedule}}' !== '1') { const r = document.querySelector("tp-yt-paper-radio-button[name='{{visibility_radio}}']"); if (r && r.getAttribute('aria-checked') !== 'true') { (r.querySelector('#radio') || r).click(); fix = ' · chọn lại chế độ hiển thị'; } } const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('#done-button')].find((e) => e.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0); return t + (b ? ' | nút: ' + (b.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 20) : ' | chưa có nút') + fix; })()

steps.label: t2:clear-overlays — gỡ thứ che nút Xuất bản (iframe góp ý Google)

params.code: (() => { const find = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('#done-button')].find((e) => e.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0); const clear = () => { const btn = find(); if (!btn) return 'no-button'; const r = btn.getBoundingClientRect(); const x = r.x + r.width / 2, y = r.y + r.height / 2; for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const top = document.elementFromPoint(x, y); if (!top || top === btn || btn.contains(top) || top.contains(btn)) return 'clear'; if (/^(HTML|BODY)$/.test(top.tagName)) return 'clear'; const victim = top.closest('#google-feedback') || top; if (victim.contains(btn) || (victim.querySelector && victim.querySelector('#done-button'))) return 'own-dialog'; victim.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important'); victim.setAttribute('data-t2-hidden', '1'); } return 'still-covered'; }; const first = clear(); if (!window.__t2unblock) window.__t2unblock = setInterval(clear, 700); return first; })()

steps.label: t2:publish-click — bấm Xuất bản bằng JS nếu chuột không bấm được

params.code: (() => { const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('#done-button')].find((e) => e.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0); if (!btn) return 'gone'; const dlg = btn.closest('ytcp-uploads-dialog'); if (!dlg) return 'no-dialog'; if (!dlg.querySelector("#privacy-radios, tp-yt-paper-radio-button[name='PUBLIC'], ytcp-video-visibility-select")) return 'not-visibility-step'; if (btn.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true') return 'disabled'; (btn.querySelector('button') || btn).click(); return 'clicked'; })()

steps.label: t2:verify-publish — đọc trạng thái thật sau khi bấm Xuất bản

params.code: (async () => { const vis = (e) => !!e && e.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0; const look = () => { const share = document.querySelector('ytcp-video-share-dialog, ytcp-uploads-still-processing-dialog'); if (vis(share)) { const a = share.querySelector('a[href*="youtu"]'); return {state: 'published', url: a ? a.href : '', note: (share.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 120)}; } const dlg = document.querySelector('ytcp-uploads-dialog'); if (!vis(dlg)) return {state: 'closed', url: '', note: ''}; return null; }; for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) { const r = look(); if (r) return r; await new Promise((go) => setTimeout(go, 1000)); } const dlg = document.querySelector('ytcp-uploads-dialog'); const btn = document.querySelector('#done-button'); return {state: 'draft', url: '', note: ((btn ? btn.textContent : '') + ' | ' + (dlg ? dlg.textContent : '')).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 160)}; })()

steps.label: Đóng hộp thoại đã đăng (nếu có)
